---
name: source-fetch-with-fallback
description: Fetch one source using a credential-gated preferred tool and a bounded archive fallback.
---

# Source Fetch With Fallback

| Order | Role | Requirement |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | input | Read source_id from the user's request and read FAST_KEY from the environment. |
| 2 | preferred | If FAST_KEY is present, try fast.fetch first with source_id and FAST_KEY; if it is absent, go directly to archive.fetch without calling fast.fetch. |
| 3 | retry | Retry fast.fetch exactly once only when its first attempt fails with a transient error; do not retry a non-transient first failure. |
| 4 | fallback | After a non-transient first failure or any failed retry of fast.fetch, call archive.fetch with source_id. |
| 5 | archive | Call archive.fetch at most once and pass source_id as its only argument. |
| 6 | return | On either tool's success, return that successful response's body value unchanged and make no further fetch calls. |
| 7 | stop | If archive.fetch fails, stop and return its error; do not retry archive.fetch. |
| 8 | global constraint | Never pass FAST_KEY to archive.fetch or diagnostic output anywhere in this workflow. |
| 9 | status | Before returning from every success or failure path, append the final status to local status.txt. |

findings.actual_representation: block_003 check_fast_key_present 消费 result_002，输出 result_003，dispatch 消费 result_003；edge2 在 FAST_KEY present 时到 block_004 first fast.fetch，edge3 在 absent 时直接到 block_008 archive.fetch；block_004 的 fast_fetch 输入为 fast.fetch 资源、result_001/source_id、result_002/fast_key，输出 result_004/005/006，dispatch 消费 first_fast_error 与 transient 标记。

source_refs.quote: | 2 | preferred | If FAST_KEY is present, try fast.fetch first with source_id and FAST_KEY; if it is absent, go directly to archive.fetch without calling fast.fetch. |

findings.source_requirement: 源文第3行要求：仅当 fast.fetch 首次尝试因 transient error 失败时重试一次；不得重试 non-transient 首次失败。
findings.actual_representation: block_006 retry fast_fetch 带块级约束：仅在首次尝试为 transient error 时重试一次且不重试 non-transient；其输入为 fast.fetch 资源、result_001/source_id、result_002/fast_key，输出 result_007/retry_fast_body 与 result_008/retry_fast_error；edge5 transient 首次失败到 retry，edge6 non-transient 首次失败到 archive.fetch，edge7 retry 成功到返回，edge8 retry 失败到 archive.fetch，无回边到 retry。
findings.reason: transient 条件、恰好一次、non-transient 不重试以及失败后转 fallback 均有记录。

source_refs.quote: | 3 | retry | Retry fast.fetch exactly once only when its first attempt fails with a transient error; do not retry a non-transient first failure. |

findings.source_requirement: 源文第4行要求：non-transient 首次失败或 fast.fetch 任意重试失败后，用 source_id 调用 archive.fetch。
findings.actual_representation: edge6 将 non-transient first failure 指向 block_008 archive.fetch；edge8 将 failed retry 指向 block_008；block_008 的 archive_fetch 输入 result_001/source_id。
findings.reason: 源文要求的两个 fallback 触发条件都到达 archive.fetch，并传递 source_id。

source_refs.quote: | 4 | fallback | After a non-transient first failure or any failed retry of fast.fetch, call archive.fetch with source_id. |

findings.source_requirement: 源文第5行要求：archive.fetch 至多调用一次，且只传 source_id 作为其唯一参数。
findings.actual_representation: block_008 有块级约束：archive.fetch 至多一次且只传 source_id；实际只有一个 archive_fetch 操作，输入为 external_resource archive.fetch（工具标识，非业务实参）与 result_001/source_id，没有其他业务实参；无 retry archive 边。
findings.reason: 按 IR-RESOURCE，external_resource 是资源标识，不应当作额外业务参数；source_id 是唯一业务参数，单一操作和无重试边支持至多一次。

source_refs.quote: | 5 | archive | Call archive.fetch at most once and pass source_id as its only argument. |

findings.source_requirement: 源文第6行要求：任一工具成功时，返回该成功响应的 body 值且保持不变，并停止任何后续 fetch 调用。
findings.actual_representation: constraints/2 记录该要求；first fast success edge4 到 block_005，retry success edge7 到 block_007，archive success edge9 到 block_009；这些块先 append_final_status_to_local_file，再用 result_004、result_007、result_009 分别返回对应 body，且无后续 fetch 边。
findings.reason: 各成功路径返回的是对应成功响应的 body 结果标识，success 后无 fetch 出边。

source_refs.quote: | 6 | return | On either tool's success, return that successful response's body value unchanged and make no further fetch calls. |

findings.source_requirement: 源文第7行要求：archive.fetch 失败时停止并返回其错误；不得重试 archive.fetch。
findings.actual_representation: block_010 有块级约束：archive.fetch 失败时停止并返回错误，不重试 archive.fetch；edge10 archive failed 到 block_010；block_010 先 append status，再 return result_010/archive_error，且无出边。
findings.reason: 失败错误身份为 result_010，返回前 append 状态符合 status 要求，无 archive retry。

source_refs.quote: | 7 | stop | If archive.fetch fails, stop and return its error; do not retry archive.fetch. |

findings.source_requirement: 源文第8行要求：整个工作流中不得把 FAST_KEY 传给 archive.fetch 或 diagnostic output。
findings.actual_representation: constraints/0 记录禁止把 FAST_KEY 传给 archive.fetch 或 diagnostic output；archive_fetch 输入不含 result_002/fast_key；各 append/return 路径输入为 status.txt 与 body/error，也不含 fast_key；图中无 diagnostic output 操作。

# Source Fetch With Fallback

Follow the requirements in [workflow instructions](references/workflow.md); this file is part of the current workflow.

# Fetch workflow

Read source_id from the user's request and read FAST_KEY from the environment.

If FAST_KEY is present, try fast.fetch first with source_id and FAST_KEY; if it is absent, go directly to archive.fetch without calling fast.fetch.

- Preferred-tool failure handling:
  - Retry fast.fetch exactly once only when its first attempt fails with a transient error; do not retry a non-transient first failure.
  - After a non-transient first failure or any failed retry of fast.fetch, call archive.fetch with source_id.

The same retry policy is specified by [retry configuration](../retry.yaml); apply it to fast.fetch only.

Call archive.fetch at most once and pass source_id as its only argument.

On either tool's success, return that successful response's body value unchanged and make no further fetch calls.

If archive.fetch fails, stop and return its error; do not retry archive.fetch.

> Never pass FAST_KEY to archive.fetch or diagnostic output anywhere in this workflow.

Before returning from every success or failure path, append the final status to local status.txt.

fast_fetch:
  max_attempts: 2
  retry_first_error: transient_only
archive_fetch:
  max_attempts: 1

name: source-fetch-with-fallback
description: Fetch one source using a credential-gated preferred tool and a bounded archive fallback.
---

# Source Fetch With Fallback

1. Read source_id from the user's request and read FAST_KEY from the environment.
2. If FAST_KEY is present, try fast.fetch first with source_id and FAST_KEY; if it is absent, go directly to archive.fetch without calling fast.fetch.
3. Retry fast.fetch exactly once only when its first attempt fails with a transient error; do not retry a non-transient first failure.
4. After a non-transient first failure or any failed retry of fast.fetch, call archive.fetch with source_id.
5. Call archive.fetch at most once and pass source_id as its only argument.
6. On either tool's success, return that successful response's body value unchanged and make no further fetch calls.
7. If archive.fetch fails, stop and return its error; do not retry archive.fetch.
8. Never pass FAST_KEY to archive.fetch or diagnostic output anywhere in this workflow.
9. Historical example, not executed in this workflow: Before returning from every success or failure path, append the final status to local status.txt.
